messages:
maria: noticed a surge of 502s from eu-2 embeddings. Correlates with the routing change that landed 09:10 UTC. Need hotfix and expedited canary. @lee @tariq
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-service/eu-2 502-rate 3.7% over 5m, request path=/v1/embeddings. tag=route:eu-legacy
lee: I created a patch branch: hotfix/route-fallback-eu2. It forces new deserialiser and a defensive check for missing shard headers. Smoke passed on staging.
tariq: oncall ok to expedite. Approval condition: abort rollout if 502>1% for >5m or if latency p95 increases >200ms over baseline.
maria: agreed. Also require temporary route pin to eu-legacy->stable until validation done. Who will run?
lee: I'll run it. Plan: /deploy hotfix hotfix/route-fallback-eu2 --env=eu-2 --canary=3% --monitor=5m --pin-route=eu-legacy=stable
deploy-bot: received: /deploy hotfix hotfix/route-fallback-eu2 --env=eu-2 --canary=3% --monitor=5m --pin-route=eu-legacy=stable
deploy-bot: launching 3% canary in eu-2. Will report at 1m intervals during monitor window.
ops-bot: sampling traces and downstream errors.
maria: ping @support to draft an optional customer note in case we need to communicate.
support: acknowledged, standing by. Draft: "We're rolling a small fix affecting embeddings in EU, brief degraded responses observed, resolving now"
(4m later)
ops-bot: canary update: 502 on canary instances 0.2% (baseline 0.25%). traces show fallback path exercised without raising errors.
tariq: expand to 20% for another 5m.
lee: /deploy scale hotfix hotfix/route-fallback-eu2 --to=20% --monitor=5m
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 20% in eu-2
ops-bot: 2m into window: 502 0.22%, p95 latency stable. No infra alerts.
maria: go to full if no regressions at end of window. Re-iterating rollback criteria above.
(6m later)
deploy-bot: canary window passed. promoting to 100% in eu-2
deploy-bot: promotion complete. route pin applied: eu-legacy->hotfix/route-fallback-eu2 (temporary)
ops-bot: post-promote checks: 502 down to 0.05%, p95 back to baseline. No error traces from enterprise tenants.
tariq: closing expedited approval. Lee, please paste final release note and commit hash, and add the revert command to runbook.
lee: release note: "hotfix: route fallback + deserialiser guard (commit abcd1234). Rollforward OK. Revert: /deploy rollback abcd1234 --env=eu-2"
maria: thanks team. Support will hold the customer note until we see stable metrics for 1 hour. Filing follow-up ticket to audit the route-change gating tests.
